scope: Post-open mechanism-capacity diagnostic on the already opened BLASTNet Case 5 and Case 2 development conditions. It is not a deployable selector, fresh external validation, resource result, curved-ray result, or real-BOST result.
scientific_question: Does worst-camera deletion stability of the deployment-visible Low-64 observation fit strictly separate every cell where direct Low64-PCGLS K11 is safe from every cell where it is unsafe relative to the adequate Zero-PCGLS K16 reference, after the one-dimensional harmonic-risk scalar failed?

frozen_parent_evidence.v221_role: Formal and independently recomputed direct Low64-PCGLS K11 and Zero-PCGLS K16 metrics provide the post-open safety labels.
frozen_parent_evidence.v222_1_role: The independently validated algebraic attribution establishes that null(A) removal preserves Case5 benefit and Case2 harm.
frozen_parent_evidence.v223_role: The independently validated v223 failure closes the one-dimensional harmonic-observability scalar and motivates a physically distinct sensor-deletion stability test.

deployment_visible_primary.name: low64_camera_jackknife_instability
deployment_visible_primary.full_fit: Compute the unregularized Moore-Penrose coefficient c from all nine camera blocks.
deployment_visible_primary.leave_one_camera_out: For each camera j in the active nine-camera set, remove its entire 16x16x2 block and compute the unregularized Moore-Penrose coefficient c_minus_j from the remaining eight blocks.
deployment_visible_primary.scalar: J=max_j ||M(c_minus_j-c)||_2 / ||M c||_2. The perturbation is evaluated on the full nine-camera response, making it invariant to an orthogonal change of Low-64 coordinates.
deployment_visible_primary.orientation: Lower J is safer. This orientation is frozen before results and may not be reversed.
deployment_visible_primary.rank_requirement: The full response and every one-camera-deleted response must each have numerical rank 64; otherwise the execution is invalid rather than a large-risk result.
deployment_visible_primary.zero_denominator_rule: Every full fitted-observation norm must be strictly positive; otherwise the execution is invalid.

cheap_control.name: max_camera_fit_residual
cheap_control.scalar: C=max_j ||M_j c-y_j||_2/||y_j||_2 using only the single full nine-camera fit and no leave-one-camera-out refit.
cheap_control.zero_denominator_rule: Every camera observation-block norm must be strictly positive; otherwise the execution is invalid.
cheap_control.role: If this cheaper per-camera residual imbalance passes the same strict separation and selected-policy gates, it explains any primary headroom without camera jackknife refits. The already failed global q0 scalar is not rerun as a new candidate.

truth_visible_capacity_labels.safe_cell: All four direct metrics satisfy the frozen strict absolute limits and direct/reference ratios are <=1.05.
truth_visible_capacity_labels.truth_role: Truth and reference metrics are deserialized only after the complete observable-feature array has been written and sealed. They are forbidden from feature construction.

strict_separation_gate.primary_margin: min(J over unsafe cells)-max(J over safe cells) must be strictly positive.
strict_separation_gate.control_margin: min(C over unsafe cells)-max(C over safe cells) must be strictly positive.
strict_separation_gate.threshold_if_positive: Arithmetic midpoint of the two boundary values; equality follows the frozen lower-is-safer rule.

selected_policy_gate.policy: Use direct Low64-PCGLS K11 when the scalar accepts; otherwise restart the adequate Zero-PCGLS K16 reference.
selected_policy_gate.dense_local_linear_algebra: One full and nine leave-one-camera-out 64-column least-squares factorizations per rig geometry, followed by batched right-hand-side solves. These are local dense algebra and are not exact A/A^T calls.

observable_before_truth_barrier.formal: Build and exclusively seal observable_features.npy and FEATURES_READY.json before deserializing v221 formal metric arrays.
observable_before_truth_barrier.independent: Independently build and exclusively seal independent_observable_features.npy and FEATURES_READY.json before deserializing v221 independent metric arrays or the truth-derived formal report.

independent_validation.formal: QR Low-64 basis and direct SVD for the full and nine reduced least-squares systems.
independent_validation.independent: SVD Low-64 span and normal-matrix eigensystems for the full and nine reduced systems; independently rebuilt reported rigs, independent labels from the sealed v221 validator, and independent recomputation of both separators, selected metrics, rig tails, and call ledgers.

decision_order: Any parent/input/source drift, non-finite value, full or leave-one-camera-out rank loss, zero denominator, camera-permutation failure, missing cell, observable-before-truth barrier failure, formal-independent mismatch, or label mismatch gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_LOW64_CAMERA_JACKKNIFE_RISK_V224.
If the primary margin is not strictly positive, conclude FAIL_LOW64_CAMERA_JACKKNIFE_RISK_OVERLAP_V224 and close this scalar camera-jackknife gate.
If the primary separates but the selected policy fails any full accuracy or cost gate, conclude FAIL_LOW64_CAMERA_JACKKNIFE_RISK_POLICY_V224.

If the primary passes and the cheaper per-camera residual control also passes, conclude PASS_LOW64_CAMERA_JACKKNIFE_BUT_VIEW_RESIDUAL_CONTROL_EXPLAINS_V224 and do not claim a distinct jackknife mechanism.

Only if the primary separates, the selected policy passes, and the cheap control does not pass may the result be called PASS_LOW64_CAMERA_JACKKNIFE_DEVELOPMENT_HEADROOM_V224. This authorizes only a separately frozen observation-only selector test.
stop_rule: A failed or inconclusive v224 closes this one-dimensional worst-camera jackknife-risk scalar. Do not tune the orientation, threshold, rank, camera grouping, normalization, solver depth, or add a larger model to rescue it.
